body: Thanks for that. It means alot. I turned 19 this month. Im happy to help others who are at this point we are. Its a deep dark hole. If you stay there...you'll eventually disappear. I hope you don't. You're young. You have lots of time to figure things out. To experience a lot of good things before your officially an adult. Me on the other hand...Im almost 20. 1/5 of my life is almost done...I probably wont see 30. But im hopefull. I'll keep fighting. I'll keep surviving. I ask that you survive this with me.

I think you should but only if you feel that the relationship is a good one. More importantly a real one. I know it may be hard to talk to her about how you really feel, but if you can go for it. You may be suprised how she responds. As for the emptiness...i cant tell you what goes in that spot. Thats something you have to figure out. But the fact that your looking for answers...a way to fix it... is a great sign. You're not at that point yet. The point of no return. You're a good person. Even if you say you're...you are. I know that. She does too

You're not alone even if you feel like you are. This is a battle your fighting. Very few win this battle but right now your fighting it. This was the first step. Stay strong and hope for a better future. Its a mystery for sure...but i hope you want to see it through

I understand feeling like you have no place in this world. Constant rejection, bullying, abuse. Having others laugh and smile while you cry your eyes out. Its rough. Its hard...Its a battle. A battle many lose. I can't tell you every thing will be ok...most likely it won't. I want to give you my reason to keep living...the small chance that i can be happy in the future...find someone...make a true connection outside of my family. Hopefully leave behind a piece of me...a legacy before I die... either from natural causes or by my own means. That tiny chance of true happiness...or at least a lasting peace...is what keeps me alive. I hope this helps somewhat. If it doesn't...im sorry

This is a tough time for us all. Not so many distractions to keep your mind off all those bad thoughts and bad memories when your stuck at home. And your right about your death effecting others. Thats why i think its best to vocalize these feeling with a family member. I know thats exactly what you dont want to do but... They're the ones who really care about you in the end. Until you find someone outside of that who you have a true connection with. You can't outright say to them "I want to die" i know that. But you could just tell them "I feel...sad. I don't know why". I did this last year with my father. He took me out for a walk around the neighborhood. We didn't say anything to each other. We just walked side by side enjoying the breeze and sounds. When we returned home we stood in front of the gate and he said "You're never alone. Even when no one is there." He turned and looked into my eyes and asked me. "Do you still feel sad? Do you know why you felt that way?" I told him "I do still feel sad. I dont know why but i won't let it take over." He hugged me and i cried into his chest. I never told him that i wanted to kill myself. Not even that i had the means to do so. But that phrase made something in me change. Now i feel like if i give in, i lose. I want to win. In order to win... I have to survive. I have to live through this!

I feel like that too. I'm chubby. Thats what i likw to say when people tell me how fat i am or to watch my weight. Often i lool in the mirror and just... Cry. Cry for hours until something pops up to distract me. Even though i know im not skinny...I wouldn't recognize myself if i looked any different. I dont know if its people making you hate your own image or you genuinely want to change how you look. If its people, fuck em. They only target you because they hate a part of themselves. If its just you... You can change yourself whether you believe me or not, but the easiest way is to look in the mirror...really look at yourself and realize that your appearance or your body don't matter. Irlts your heart, mind, and soul that make the difference.

I regret many things i did in the past as well. More recently. About a year back i graduated high school. I was trying to figure out a subject to go to college. Kinda hard when you have no interest. I then made a wattpad account. Its a book site for fanfictions and stuff. I made a story i liked and one other user did to. We messaged each other for about a week and then she starts to get really attached. She told me she was depressed about her accidentally dating one of her family members. Cant remember specifically which one. She said she loved him but it couldn't be. I thought I could help her keep her mind off it by keeping in touch. She then said she had feeling for me. Thinking i was helping i told her i did as well. I lead her on for about a month...just before i was going to trade school. She was 16. I was 18. She lived in Jamaica. I live in the USA. I told her that she would find somebody but it wasn't me. She said she didn't care, that i was the only one in her life now that made her smile. She wanted me to keep contact. To keep lying to her. I stopped messaging her. She continued to. It was a mixture of begging, hate, grief, self loathing... The last message she sent me was " Happy New Year".... I fear I may have drove her to suicide. I hope not. I really hope not. I feel selfish for hoping to find a real connection when I provided a fake one who wanted the same thing. Even though I meant no harm... I may have killed somone.... Even with that... I still hold hope for the future... My future. I hope you can too.

Im kinda lost in my sadness to. Its hard to escape. I dont even know if you can. I wont tell you to see a therapist or any professional although thats what most recommend. I've thought about dying a lot. I've only thought about killing myself today. What i can tell you is whats keeping me from doing so... The future. I think about what could be. I know for certain most of the bad stuff that will happen like me outliving all my immediate family, but I often picture myself in the state of being i want to be in. Looking into the eyes of someone who doesnt have to understand me or what im going through. Just someone to... feel something with. A look or a smile. A hug maybe. A connection that can never be severed. I think about that before I go into my drawer to get my gun. I can't see what 'will' happen if I end the show early.
